type Choice = { kind: "a"; a: number } | { kind: "b"; b: string };
function mutable(value: Choice) {
  let kind = value.kind;
  if (kind === "a") return value.a;
  return value.b;
}
function annotated(value: Choice) {
  const kind: Choice["kind"] = value.kind;
  if (kind === "a") return value.a;
  return value.b;
}
function chained(value: Choice) {
  const kind = value.kind;
  const alias = kind;
  if (alias === "a") return value.a;
  return value.b;
}
function reassigned(value: Choice) {
  const kind = value.kind;
  value = { kind: "b", b: "after" };
  if (kind === "a") return value.a;
  return value.b;
}
